name: Accessibility regression loop
objective: Repair a newly introduced accessibility failure with reproducible automated evidence and required human review.

trigger.cadence_or_event: An accessibility check fails on a pull request or deployment preview.

intake.selection_rule: Work only on a reproducible regression tied to the reported route, viewport, browser, and interaction.

workspace.isolation: Branch or clean worktree based on the failing commit.
disallowed_actions: change shared design tokens without owner approval

agents.responsibility: Confirm the failure on the exact route, browser, viewport, and interaction.
Apply the smallest standards-aligned component or style change.
Rerun the focused automated rule, keyboard path, and adjacent tests.
Judge manual criteria and ambiguous semantic or assistive-technology behavior.

gates: original rule passes in the same environment
keyboard order and visible focus remain coherent
accessible name role and state are correct
no rule or threshold was weakened

state.update_rule: Record the affected users, rule, reproduction, patch, automated result, and outstanding manual criteria after every attempt.

exit.success: The exact regression is repaired, adjacent checks pass, and required manual criteria are approved.
exit.stop_without_success: The issue cannot be reproduced, needs product judgment, conflicts with the design system, or exceeds the retry budget.
